name_input: ANJALI LABTECH LIMITED; ANJALI DIAMONDS PRIVATE LIMITED
actual_hs_list: 7104.91 — synthetic (lab-grown) diamonds, unmounted/unset, polished (rough and polished LGD: 3.2 lakh ct polished LGD/yr, 13 lakh ct rough LGD/yr per company site)
7104.21 — synthetic diamonds, unworked or simply sawn/cleaved (rough LGD grown in own MPCVD reactors)
7104.99 — synthetic stones other than diamonds (possible, not evidenced on site)
7113.19 — jewellery of precious metal, whether or not plated/clad (LGD-studded gold jewellery, 7 categories, OEM/private label)
7116.20 — articles of precious/semi-precious stones (LGD-set articles, if sold as non-jewellery articles)
8486.20 / 8486.90 — machines and parts for the manufacture of semiconductor devices (MPCVD reactor systems; 5,635+ units installed per company site) — code family to be confirmed by technical spec
3818.00 — chemical elements doped for use in electronics, in disc/wafer form (diamond wafers / 'diamond in semiconductor' vertical)
product_summary: Vertically integrated lab-grown diamond group, Surat (registered office Anjali House, Varachha Road, Surat; sales office Bharat Diamond Bourse, Mumbai; US office Anjali Diamond Inc, New York). Four declared verticals on anjalilabtech.com: (1) MPCVD (microwave plasma CVD) reactor systems — 'India's largest manufacturer of MPCVD machines', 5,635+ installed; (2) lab-grown diamonds — certified (IGI/GIA/HRD) and non-certified, ten cuts (round, princess, emerald, oval, cushion, radiant, asscher, marquise, heart, pear), wholesale/bulk; (3) diamond wafers / 'diamond in semiconductor'; (4) LGD-studded jewellery, seven categories, OEM and private label. Company states it was incorporated in Surat in 2021 as Anjali Diamonds Private Limited and now trades as Anjali LabTech Limited. No product-level price lists, HS codes or shipment documents are published on the site.
role_hint: manufacturer (own MPCVD reactor fleet, own growing, polishing and jewellery manufacturing divisions with named heads of MPCVD manufacturing, LGD growing, robotics polishing, manual polishing and jewellery manufacturing). Not a pure trader; however the Mumbai Bharat Diamond Bourse office and New York sales office indicate a significant distribution/trading arm alongside manufacturing.
comment: HS 7104.91 is CORRECT for the core polished lab-grown diamond line and is corroborated by the company's own product page (certified/non-certified polished LGD in ten cuts, sold wholesale). Match = partial, not exact, because the declaration covers only one of four declared verticals. Missing from the declaration: (a) rough/unworked synthetic diamond 7104.21 — the site states 13 lakh ct rough LGD grown annually, which is a separate 6-digit heading from polished; (b) LGD-studded jewellery 7113.19 — a full manufacturing division with a VP Jewellery and a Head of Jewellery Manufacturing; (c) MPCVD reactor systems, which are capital equipment (8486 family, to be confirmed against technical spec) and are the company's stated largest business by unit count (5,635+ machines); (d) diamond wafers / semiconductor diamond (3818.00 or 7104 depending on form). INDUSTRY MISCLASSIFICATION: the claimed industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food & FMCG) is entirely wrong — this is a diamond, diamond-capital-equipment and jewellery company; the industry field must be corrected to precious stones / jewellery / diamond technology. Note the entity-name issue: the batch lists two names, and the site itself states 'Anjali LabTech Limited (Formerly Known as Anjali Diamonds Private Limited)', i.e. one legal person after a name change, not two suppliers — this should be verified against the MCA record before the batch is split or merged. All product claims above are from the company's own website (anjalilabtech.com homepage, /products/lab-grown-diamonds, /about-us) and are therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line, invoice or B-L was available to me in this HS-only scope, so no shipment-level corroboration is asserted. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: company is retained with corrected/expanded code list and verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Revenue, export volumes, CIN/PAN and registry status were out of scope and are not reported here.
